target_customer: Spanish-speaking consumers in Mexico paying a subscription for guided health and habit programs
problem: People struggle to keep healthy habits after crash diets; Kodda offered community plus professional-made programs to make lifestyle change lasting.
business_model: Consumer subscription app with programs from nutritionists and trainers, plus partner studios
product_category: Consumer digital health and wellness habit app

technical_complexity.rationale: A content and habit tracking mobile app with subscriptions is standard consumer app engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Habit tracking and wellness content are easy to copy; a launch write-up warned the habit app space was very crowded.

market_need_then: Growing consumer interest in wellness after 2020, and a launch write-up reported over 2,400 downloads in the first month, but willingness to pay in Mexico was unproven.

branding.domain_note: Used kodda.com; the site returned a 503 error when checked.

identity.voice_and_tone: Community framing: accompanies you in your transformation

branding.community_and_virality: Community was part of the pitch; no press or fan evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive invented name but with a double d spelling that invites errors and no sourced evidence of brand traction.

pivots.from: Consumer habit and wellness community app
pivots.to: Positioning blending insurtech and consumer wellness (per one profile)

outcome_analysis: Kodda joined YC in Summer 2021 with a habit and wellness community app from Monterrey and is now listed as Inactive. No shutdown notice, post-mortem or date was found, so the cause is not public, and no failure factors are asserted.
notes: Funding unverified and conflicting: Bouncewatch lists a 130K seed dated 2021-09, a newsletter lists 1.75M from YC, JAM Fund and GMV Capital; neither confirmed by a primary or second independent source, so no round is recorded. The pivot toward insurtech comes from one profile and is undated. No dated competitor coverage was found, so the list is empty. Website returned HTTP 503 so it may be dead. An app store listing exists for a later Kodda app. Completeness pass: the 130K seed dated 2021-09-01 is recorded from Bouncewatch alone (investor Y Combinator); startup-seeker lists 125K raised to date. The 1.75M figure from a newsletter was not found again and is not recorded.
